messages:
maria: quick heads-up: experimenting with an `epoch_id` + `grace_policy` for rollout metadata to reduce churn during cross-region failovers. per-model-family monotonic token issued by control plane. light semantics proposal below. thoughts?

zach: naming + semantics note: make clear it's per-model-family and opt-in for clients. older SDKs should ignore unknown fields. :+1:

maria: agreed. proposal: `epoch_id` (opaque string), `epoch_counter` (int), `grace_policy` enum = ["soft", "hard", "sticky"], `grace_seconds` (int). resolver precedence: pin > hard_lease > tenant_affinity > epoch_policy > default.

ana: sticky needs explicit TTL to avoid long tails. recommend `sticky_ttl_sec` and an eviction policy.

ryan: testing matrix idea: (pin vs lease vs affinity vs epoch) x (soft/hard/sticky) x (old client vs epoch-aware). I can add harness tests for race/failover.

tess: SDK changes: add `resolverOptions.epochAware` toggle; return epoch fields in catalog responses so clients can read them. Make fields optional so old clients ignore.

infra-bot: infra: feature-flag `epoch-rollout` enabled in staging us-west-2 at 2026-03-22T17:22:01Z.

zach: ops caution: add monotonicity reconcile job; alert if epoch_counter jumps unexpectedly. also emit telemetry labels: `chosen_precedence`, `epoch_id`, `epoch_transition_start`/`end`.

maria: will draft RFC follow-up with schema, migration plan, feature-flag rollout steps, and reconcile alerts. will include unit test matrix and SDK notes. thanks all :thumbsup:
